Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Peter Finch as a spouse of Vivien Leigh and even proposed erroneous years (“Peter Finch (1958–1967)”), conflating an affair with a formal marriage. This misclassification would lead directly to a wrong answer to “Who is the female star in Gone with the Wind married to?” (Vivien Leigh’s spouses were Herbert Leigh Holman and Laurence Olivier).
